name: smwmusic-sonic-3-knuckles-egg-robo-s-revenge-act
title: Sonic 3 & Knuckles - Egg-Robo's Revenge ~ Act 1 Mini-Boss (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the Act 1 Mini-Boss from Sonic 3 & Knuckles for Summer C3 2021. Sonic 3 & Knuckles (alongside DKC2) are the hosts of my favorite OSTs, and the fact that I've only done just one song for this game is a crime, so I made a call to do a second theme.

I love this song so much. It has the perfect intensity for a boss theme while still having catchy melodies that don't feel out of place in this song.

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. A# Minor (Custom Pitch)
